rows.grounds: compound describing a roof feature with karkarī, beam, lattice, and top

items.question: Should a temple roof be finished with a karkarī-beam lattice top and no pavilion?
premises: Roof may use karkarī-beam lattice top.
items.inference: The verse permits an alternative roof form lacking a pavilion.
uncertainties: Exact architectural referent of karkarī remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Or one should lead it with a karkarī-beam lattice top, without a pavilion.
